#include "ara/tsync/synchronized_time_base_consumer.h"
Description:
Register a notifier function which is called if a new time precision snapshot is available.
A maximum of one notifier can be registered. Every further registration overwrites the current
registration. The Tsync will not do any queuing. If needed it has to be done within the notifier.
